errors.text: The hypothesis centers on refractory HEAs with BCC-based microstructures rather than the as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA containing FCC and B2 phases.

It predicts a transition primarily as a function of aging time at 700–1000 °C, whereas the target transition is temperature-dependent within approximately 550–750 °C, with embrittlement near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.

Positive mixing enthalpy is treated as a driver of chemical ordering, although it more directly favors demixing or phase separation; the cited evidence does not establish L12 or B2 ordering as the cause of a ductility minimum.

The proposed fixed-temperature sequence of ordered-phase formation followed by dissolution or benign coarsening is not supported by the cited evidence and is not generally expected without a specific metastable transformation pathway.
